description.narrative: QADER will conduct psychosocial support and counseling (group and individual) to members of affected communities, with a focus on PwDs, women, and children. To mitigate the psychosocial effects of ongoing violence, foster peer-to-peer support networks, and ensurepathways for referrals to specialized services for those requiring additional assistance. This approach promotes emotional resilience and supports the reintegration of affected individuals into their communities. Also, Qader will provide children both with and without disabilities, and their mothers the opportunity to participate in recreational activities within a safe and supportive environment. In response to the urgent needs of persons with disabilities (PwDs) and their families in the northern West Bank, particularly in Jenin, which has been significantly affected by recurrent military incursions and violence. This volatile context has resulted in heightened psychosocial distress and material challenges for vulnerable families, particularly mothers and children. QADER will also focus on selected CBOs in the targeted locations with the needed support to enhance their capacity to provide responsive and inclusive services / programs. This support to include: Material support (Assistive devices, equipment and tools, furniture needed for the service provision, Gender inclusive first aid kit,....etc) Accessibility support (physical adaptions to ensure access of PwDto the CBOs facilities) and Trainings (Training on disability inclusion in emergencies) "This aims to address the critical needs ofPwDs, whose access to essential relief materials is hindered either by the deliberate destruction of civilian infrastructure duringmilitary operations or by the economic vulnerabilities faced by households supporting PwDs.

participating-org.narrative:
QADER for Community Development is a Palestinian non-governmental, not-for-profit, and independent organization dedicated to promoting better well-being of persons with disabilities in Palestine. Since its founding in 2008, QADER has assumed its functional responsibility thereinafter addressing the disability issue from a human rights perspective, and demonstrated a rights’ based approach in tackling the various issues of persons with disabilities.
QADER has driving strategies for its core programs; mainly, enhancing commitment of public institutions towards fulfilling the rights and needs of PwD, enhancing disability awareness, promoting performanceof non-state actors in addressing the needs of PwD, and fostering active participation of PwD in social and economic life. QADER focuses on development models that are based on thorough analysis of the context and needs of persons with disabilities and key stakeholders. Several models were developed, piloted, replicated, or scaled up in many areas and fields, including mainstreaming disability in local authorities <(>&<)> higher education institutions, institutionalizing awareness in the education system, enhancing socio-economic participation of person with disabilities and their families.
Since its founding, QADER made significant contributions in the disability sector. In fact, the professional capacity of QADER’s governance body, management and staff has fostered fast track developments, both at the level of program development and internal capacities.
QADER in recognized for its expertise in the disability sector, and specifically in supporting the capacities of relevant stakeholders among public institutions and non-state actors tomainstream disability within their programs and services
